data.name: Ojaswini
data.gender_notes: Ojaswini is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ojaswini is a Sanskrit name for a girl, derived from the word ‘Ojas’ which means ‘vitality, energy, and power’. In Hindu mythology, Ojaswini is considered a form of the goddess Durga, who represents strength, power, and courage. This name is believed to bring prosperity, happiness, and good fortune to the bearer. The name Ojaswini carries the meaning “Vitality, Energy, Power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ojaswini usually hope their child will grow to embody vitality, energy, power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ojaswini belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Vitality, Energy, Power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ojaswini total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

This name is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality, connecting the bearer to the goddess Durga and her divine qualities of power, strength, and courage.

historical_references.reference: Ojaswini was an ancient Hindu goddess who was the personification of vital energy, strength, and power. She was often invoked for protection and to bestow strength and vigor.
historical_references.context: Ancient Hindu religious texts and rituals

historical_references.reference: Later, Ojaswini came to be identified with the goddess Durga and was worshipped as a form of the mother goddess. She was believed to protect the devotee from evil and grant them victory over their enemies.
